spec_evidence.checked: Walked both cached specs: OLD paths contains /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/events/queries/alerts while NEW does not; NEW paths contains /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/events/queries carrying the method set (get). The alerts sub-resource family is gone from NEW entirely; the generic queries routes (present in both OLD and NEW) are the surviving surface, so alert-scoped filtering must move into query parameters or client-side logic.

Update raw URL builders, route constants and API client wrappers accordingly.
